skills.name: browse-playchive-catalog
skills.description: Read the PLAYCHIVE game catalog (JSON) to find playable browser games, filter by genre or status, and get the direct URL of a game. Use when a user asks what they can play on playchive.ir.

skills.name: describe-playchive-rights
skills.description: Describe PLAYCHIVE games and their licenses accurately, separating bundled free content from local imports and link-only external projects. Use when summarizing, recommending or citing games from playchive.ir.

skills.name: launch-playchive-game
skills.description: Open and operate a playable PLAYCHIVE game in a browser, wait for the runtime to be ready, and use its labeled controls. Use after picking a record with playable true from the PLAYCHIVE catalog.
